title: VooPoo Drag 6 Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Drag 6 Vape Kit is a powerful sub ohm device designed for exceptional Direct To Lung (DTL) vaping. Powered by a substantial 4400mAh built-in battery, it delivers a consistent power output ranging from 5W up to 220W. This integrated battery design provides enhanced stability and safety, while the 3A USB-C fast charging capability ensures the device can be fully recharged in under two hours, or approximately 105 minutes. Driven by the advanced GENE TT 3.0 chip, the device offers faster response times and highly stable performance. It features three distinct power modes to suit different vaping styles. Smart Mode automatically detects the installed coil and sets the recommended wattage, RBA Mode allows for full manual control across the 5W to 220W range, and TC-TRC Mode provides temperature control options. Adjusting the wattage is smooth and intuitive thanks to the dedicated Precision Control Wheel located just below the tank connection. Navigating these settings is made incredibly simple via the large 1.66-inch TFT colour display, which offers three built-in themes. The Drag 6 also features multiple unlock options, including a capacitive touch sensor that automatically locks the device when you put it down and unlocks it when picked up, effectively preventing accidental firing. Further peace of mind is provided by six comprehensive safety protections, including short-circuit, overcharge, and overheating protection. The kit includes the 2ml TPD-compliant Uforce-X Tank, which boasts a convenient slide-to-open top-fill port for clean and easy refills. Its Golden Triangle Airflow Structure and rotary adjustment dial allow you to fine-tune your draw with precision. Supplied with 0.15 Ohm and 0.3 Ohm PnP X mesh coils , this setup is highly recommended for use with high VG e-liquids of 70% VG or more, delivering rich flavour and immensely satisfying vapour production.
